About the Great Northern Monday Riding 101 Ride group ride

A ride for people who have never ridden in a group on the road. Shop guides teach hand signals, drafting and etiquette at a casual 12–16 mph. Any bike welcome. Distance grows to about 20 miles as the summer goes on. Free parking in the ramp after 5 pm.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
